company.name: onxMaps
company.shortDescription: onxMaps is a Montana-based mobile apps company which provide maps for hunters and other outdoor recreation.
company.description:
onXmaps is a Montana-based mobile apps company which provide maps for hunters and other outdoor recreation. The company aggregates nationwide data on property ownership, trails, permitted land use, and many other parameters. World-class GPS and mapping technologies present customized information to users, tailored to their off-pavement activities and locations.

Since the Company’s 2009 founding, onX has used hunters’ back-country experience and feedback to deliver products with ever wider appeal.

productsAndServices.description: A GPS mapping and hunting-planning app with public and private land boundaries, landowner data, offline maps, hunting-specific layers, scouting tools, and cellular trail-camera integration.
productsAndServices.name: onX Hunt

productsAndServices.description: A GPS trail-navigation app for off-road vehicles that provides mapped trails, land-ownership data, offline maps, route planning, turn-by-turn navigation, and trail information for ATVs, UTVs, SxS vehicles, trucks, and overlanding.
productsAndServices.name: onX Offroad

productsAndServices.description: A GPS mapping and route-planning app for hiking, backpacking, mountain biking, backcountry skiing, and climbing, with offline maps, 3D terrain, LiDAR topography, trail data, weather, avalanche information, and land-access layers.
productsAndServices.name: onX Backcountry

productsAndServices.description: A fishing-locations and fisheries-information app that helps anglers find lakes, filter opportunities by species, assess fish size and abundance, and identify trophy or keeper potential.
productsAndServices.name: onX Fish

productsAndServices.description: A team mapping and field-operations service that provides shared mapping data, offline maps, land and terrain layers, route navigation, collaboration, and centralized license management for professional organizations.
productsAndServices.name: onX for Business

productsAndServices.description: A satellite-imagery service providing medium-resolution imagery updated approximately every two weeks, with historical views for assessing wildfire, flood, snow, ice, mud, and water-level changes.
productsAndServices.name: onX Recent Imagery

aiResearchSummary.text: onxMaps is researching methods and systems for compressing digital elevation model data to reduce network traffic by efficiently handling map data, as described in 'Methods and systems for compressing digital elevation model data.' Additionally, they are developing techniques for providing a real-time viewshed visualization, enabling generation of viewshed maps using light source and elevation data, as detailed in 'Methods and systems for providing a real-time viewshed visualization.' These efforts focus on map data efficiency and visualization.
